# 1,200.00 USD moved from C, which holds 1,000.00, to B, at 1.40.
#
# The first 1,000.00 is a transfer: C's dollars move to B, and no cost basis is
# drawn down or opened for them. The other 200.00 takes C below zero, so it is
# a borrowing: 200.00 arrives on the held side at B and 200.00 on the owed side
# at C, each opening a cost basis at 1.40.
#
# Imported into the book usd_moved_out_of_an_empty_account.txt makes.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_balance_past_zero_has_a_cost_basis_on_the_other_side.py.
2034-02-01 * "Move 1,200.00 USD from C to B"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD C -1200.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "7/5"
		value: "-1680.00"
		guid: "0a0a0000000000000000000000000006"
	Assets:USD B 1200.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "7/5"
		value: "1680.00"
		guid: "0a0a0000000000000000000000000007"
